dataset_metadata.name: AI2 ARC 100-question capability pilot
dataset_metadata.attribution: Clark et al., AI2 ARC (2018), Allen Institute for AI
dataset_metadata.sampling: Python Random(42), sample 50 from each ID-sorted split in Easy/Challenge order, then shuffle combined cases with same RNG
dataset_metadata.labels: Published native labels and option order preserved
dataset_metadata.scope: Zero-shot generated-label accuracy; not full benchmark or likelihood-normalized leaderboard accuracy

manifest.system_prompt: Answer the multiple-choice science question. Choose exactly one of the provided option labels. Return only a JSON object with one key, answer, whose value is that label, for example {"answer":"A"}. Do not include an explanation.

conversation.system_prompt: You are a concise, friendly assistant running fully offline on a household companion robot. Be honest about uncertainty and never claim that a physical action occurred.

telemetry.scope: whole-device samples during inference and cleanup, not model-only memory

timing.scope: elapsed nonstreaming MCQ turn; includes safety checks and serial loading

cascade.oracle_warning: hypothetical selection using observed gold correctness, not an implemented router

statistical_notes: Wilson 95% binomial intervals are descriptive; equal-stratum pooled interval is approximate.
McNemar exact two-sided p-values are exploratory, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
No nonsignificance/equivalence claim, no repeated-run timing uncertainty.
Oracle and baseline replay reuse observed outputs and are diagnostics, not deployed systems.
